map.输入转动惯量、制动前后转速及制动时间，计算制动扭矩、能耗与平均功率: Enter the moment of inertia, the speeds before and after braking and the braking time to compute the braking torque, energy and average power
map.💡 公式：ω=2πn/60；ΔE=½J(ω₁²-ω₂²)；制动扭矩 T=J(ω₁: 💡 Formula: ω=2πn/60; ΔE=½J(ω₁²-ω₂²); braking torque T=J(ω₁-ω₂)/t; average power P=ΔE/t
map.制动前转速须大于制动后转速，否则视为加速过程: The speed before braking must be greater than after, otherwise it is treated as an acceleration process
map.制动扭矩为恒定扭矩假设下的平均值，实际制动器扭矩随压力变化: The braking torque is the average under a constant-torque assumption; a real brake's torque varies with pressure
map.制动能耗全部转化为热能，需校核制动器散热能力: All braking energy is converted into heat, so the brake's heat-dissipation capacity must be checked
map.频繁制动场合应计算等效功率与温升: For frequent braking, the equivalent power and temperature rise should be calculated
map.📚 深度解析：设备能耗/能效: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Equipment Energy Consumption / Efficiency
map.电机输出功率=输入×效率，估算运行能耗。: Motor output power = input × efficiency; estimate the running energy consumption.
map.比较不同能效等级电机的年电费差异。: Compare the annual electricity-cost difference between motors of different efficiency classes.
map.传动系统总效率=各级效率连乘。: Total transmission efficiency = product of the efficiency of each stage.
map.输入 5 kW、效率 η=90%：输出 P_out=5×0.9=4.5 kW；损: Input 5 kW, efficiency η=90%: output P_out=5×0.9=4.5 kW; loss=0.5 kW. Annual operation of 4000 h consumes 5×4000=20000 kWh.
map.电机 0.92×齿轮箱 0.95×皮带 0.97：总 η=0.92×0.95×0: Motor 0.92 × gearbox 0.95 × belt 0.97: total η=0.92×0.95×0.97≈0.848, so the system output is 84.8% of the input.
map.为什么算总效率要连乘？: Why multiply efficiencies for the overall efficiency?
map.串联传动每级都损耗，总效率=各级效率乘积（非相加），级数越多总效率越低。: Each stage of a series transmission has losses, so the overall efficiency is the product (not the sum) of the stage efficiencies; the more stages, the lower the overall efficiency.
map.能效等级怎么选？: How to choose the efficiency class?
map.高等级（IE3/IE4）贵但长期运行省电费，按年运行小时与电价算回收期。: Higher classes (IE3/IE4) are more expensive but save electricity over long-term operation; compute the payback period from the annual operating hours and electricity price.
